title: AGV Pista GP RR Iridium Gold Race Visor
features: Optical Class 1 injection-molded 5mm race-thickness polycarbonate face shield
Iridium gold vacuum metalized mirror coating reduces harsh track glare (12% VLT)
Pinlock 120 MaxVision ready with tear-off mounting posts for competition racing
Patented Visor Lock System (VLS) prevents accidental high-speed aerodynamic opening
description:
Engineered to withstand harsh ultraviolet radiation and dense condensation, the AGV Pista GP RR Iridium Gold Race Visor from AGV elevates visual clarity across demanding weather conditions. Built with Hydrophobic Rain-Shedding Exterior Coating with Perimeter Airtight Seal, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Toolless quick-release pivot lever swap in 10 seconds).

The AGV Pista GP RR Iridium Gold Race Visor is an essential visual clarity upgrade from AGV. By delivering edge-to-edge optical fidelity and bulletproof fog prevention, it dramatically improves situational awareness across unpredictable climates.
